evidence.ACL: Low-grade partial tear/sprain of the anterior cruciate ligament
evidence.MCL: High-grade tear of the medial collateral ligament.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: evidence of small horizontal oblique tear extending to the femoral surface.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Mild nonspecific signal changes at the anterior horn compatible with low-grade tearing. Evidence of small Wrisberg rip-type longitudinal tear of the periphery of the posterior horn.
evidence.Contusion: Additional small area of bone marrow edema on the medial side of medial femoral condyle without evidence of associated fracture.
evidence.Fracture: Comminuted mildly displaced avulsion fracture of the tibial spine
